title: Surveyor 3 touches down
text: Surveyor 3 landed on April 20, 1967, in Oceanus Procellarum on the Moon. It bounced twice before settling, then used its robotic arm to test the lunar soil.

title: A visit from Apollo 12
text: In November 1969, Apollo 12 astronauts removed parts from Surveyor 3, including its TV camera, and returned them to Earth. The rest of the lander remains on the Moon.

picture.credit: NASA (Exact: NASA / Johnson Space Center / Alan L. Bean)

title: Phoenix lands in the Martian arctic
text: Phoenix landed in the Martian arctic on May 25, 2008, and kept working until winter darkness arrived.

title: A later look from orbit
text: A later orbiter image of the landing site showed signs of ice damage to a solar panel.

picture.description: Illustration of a lander resting on the Martian surface (not a real photo)
picture.credit: NASA / JPL-Caltech / University of Arizona / Lockheed Martin (Artist's Illustration)

title: The mission ends
text: NASA ended the Phoenix mission in May 2010, after final attempts to listen for a signal.

picture.credit: NASA / JPL-Caltech / University of Arizona (Artist's Illustration)
